soul: New Life Project is a survival-then-corruption sandbox where the player's primary enemy is the world itself — random assault, escalating rent, and daily allure decay create constant pressure to advance economically and mentally. The core fantasy is transformation: starting as a stranded Christian virgin (corrupt=-25) with no home, no money, and enemies at every dark corner, and choosing how far to slide — from cleaning tables for £49/shift to running a camshow, joining a pimp, enrolling in school prostitution rings, or crumbling into Tim the therapist's captivity. The game is honest that the world will come for you regardless of your choices; corruption is the answer to pressure, not just a meter to climb.
skill_blindspots: A1 CONTRADICTION (cascade model): The skill models corruption as a self-directed arc the PLAYER chooses to pursue. In NLP, the world forces corruption passively (daily floor: if corrupt<5 → +2/sleep) AND punishes inaction (no money → rentRape → +30 trauma → spiral). The game has TWO drivers of corruption: player-chosen lewd acts AND environmental punishment. The cascade model only models the first. Evidence: sleepAlleyIntro (first scene) forces corrupt+3 and allure-15 before the player makes any choice.

A2 CONTRADICTION (double-lock): The dominant gate pattern is corrupt-only (154 passages with corrupt gate vs 9 with both corrupt+NPC). Most NPC sex scenes gate on corrupt alone, not NPC relation. The NPC relation var ($lily, $zack) is primarily used for social content and unlocking the NPC's apartment — not for double-locking lewd content. The double-lock is the exception, not the rule. Evidence: cookZackSex gates only on corrupt≥80 && inhib≤70, not on $zack≥N. lilyRoom fool: corrupt≥80 only.

A3 CONTRADICTION (no-decay odometer model): $allure decays -15 every sleep and must be maintained by showering and beauty shop visits. This is a daily maintenance THROTTLE attached to a stat that gates content (allure≥40/45/60). The skill has no concept of a maintenance meter — only permanent odometers and arousal throttle. A maintenance loop where the player must perform daily upkeep or lose access to content is architecturally distinct. Also: $corrupt has a passive floor boost (if <5 → +1/sleep) which is a slow forced ramp, not pure player choice.

A9 CONTRADICTION (no-failure frontier): The game has genuine spiral failure states — asylum, TimHouse capture, trauma accumulation — that constrain the player into a separate degraded-life sub-game. TimHouse is explicitly called a bad end in-game ('RESTART if you could'). The skill models an endless sandbox with no failure. This game has a trauma axis that functions as a slow game-over if neglected. Evidence: asylum passage, TimHouse passage ('You were taken by Tim. There's no way out'), alleyKidnap at alleyCount≥21.

A10 CONTRADICTION (MC as escalating agent): Many content deliveries are ENVIRONMENT-INITIATED, not player-clicked. alleyRape, sleepSRape, parkRape, rentRape, dadRape, alleyKidnap are all automatic/RNG events triggered by stat conditions the player cannot fully control. The predator/climber posture is undermined by a hostile world model where high allure is a vulnerability, not an advantage. The skill has no concept of 'predatory environment' as a content delivery vector.

A4 (four lanes) — PARTIALLY INAPPLICABLE: The game does not use the four-lane NPC canvas structure. There is no persistent NPC hub-menu (Lane 1). NPC interaction happens through inline conditional branches within location passages. The camshow system has its own FOLLOWER PROGRESSION axis (followers≥429/1200/2600/6400 thresholds) that gates content tiers — this is a social-media growth ladder with no equivalent in the lane model. Evidence: newCamshow passage gating on both corrupt AND followers thresholds.

INHIBITION AS SECOND PLAYER STAT: The skill vocabulary has no concept of a separate 'inhibition' meter that runs in the OPPOSITE direction from corruption and gates the same content. $inhib (0-150, starts 100-125) decays as corruption rises, and gates content from BELOW (inhib≤50 required for park flash, inhib≤70 for mansion brother). This creates a two-stat player-state space (corrupt up, inhib down) that the skill collapses into a single corruption cascade. 76 passages gate on inhibition. Evidence: parkFlash (inhib≤50 && corrupt≥25), bouncerMouth (allure≥45 && arousal≥10 && corrupt≥20 && inhib≤70).

TRAUMA AS STRUCTURAL PRESSURE AXIS: The skill has no vocabulary for a negative-welfare meter that accumulates from NPC-initiated events and drives the player toward auxiliary failure content (asylum, TimHouse). Trauma is not gated on player-corruption tier — it rises from being victimized and falls through spending money on therapy/massages. It creates a separate 'mental health economy' orthogonal to the corruption arc. The skill only models meters that rise with player escalation, not meters that rise when the environment victimizes the player.

UPBRINGING SYSTEM (character creation → permanent stat delta): The game has a character creation screen with upbringing choices (chrisvirg, athletic, brat, airhead, attwhore, loud, nerd) that apply permanent stat deltas at game start (chrisvirg: inhib+25, corrupt-25; athletic: strength+4, cardio+6; brat: corrupt+7). This sets a character-differentiated starting state. The skill has no concept of a character-creation phase that modifies the initial state of the corruption/inhibition meters.

MAINTENANCE LOOP (shower/beauty/allure): The daily allure decay (SleepWidget) creates a recurring maintenance task — shower every day or lose content access. This is architecturally closer to a need-meter (hunger/hygiene) than a corruption odometer or arousal throttle. The skill models no need/maintenance axis and would not generate this design concept.

Time cost: each district entry consumes 5 minutes ($addmins 5). No fast-travel, no AP cost to move between districts (AP/stam costs on activities within). Day/night gates: some activities time-restricted (racetrack 8PM-3AM, car theft 21:00-03:00, striptease club 19:00 close). Clock advances in real time within activities. Sleep at Bedroom triggers NewDay + full day advance to 08:00. No world map — linear district-to-district road structure.
endings_frontier: Two named endings found: Yacht Party Deals Final and Yacht Party Orgy Final — both are recurring deal-close sub-passages within the Yacht Party event (not hard game-ending screens). The Yacht party recurs on a cooldown (yacht_party_cd); the "Final" passages are just the confirmed-deal moment within that session, then return to Yacht Party hub. No hard ending/win-screen detected. No passage named "Game Over" or "You Win" found in 680 passages. The Whiteboard's 7-goal checklist gating is the mid-act climax (gang creation), NOT the end state. Post-gang content is the plateau: territory wars, district capture, lab upgrades, heist chains, brothel/nightclub ownership. The game is an endless sandbox with a major mid-game threshold. Failure states are setbacks not ends: combat loss → Home (rep loss); territory revolt (morale < 20) → re-capture arc; heat=100 → activities blocked, then washed down. No actual lose-the-game condition confirmed.
failure_states:
REAL setbacks exist (distinguishing this from pure A9):

COMBAT LOSS: HP depleted → Downtown Lose/Gym Lose/etc. → $reputation -= random(30,50), forced home, $p_hp recovery required. Can lose fights repeatedly.

TERRITORY REVOLT: band_morale < 20 → heat_downtown/suburbs/outskirts widget fires → district flipped back to faction control (downtown_state = false, gangs_str boosted). Requires re-capturing via combat.

GANG ARREST (heat events): When heat high and accomplices_list.length >= 30, police arrest random gang members → permanent NPC removal.

ASSET SEIZURE EVENTS (heat_widgets): heat events include losing dirty money, losing drugs, losing gang members.

DEBT SPIRAL: Daily expenses without income → $money goes negative → auto-loans accumulate → daily repayments compound. No bankruptcy wipe detected but escalating debt burden is a pressure spiral.

HEIST FAILURE: HeistBH/CH/etc. have lose paths with heat spikes (60-80%) and item loss.

NO PERMANENT GAME-OVER: All failures are recoverable setbacks within the sandbox. The game specifically says "You lost. It happens. Head home to recover." — recovery is always available.
soul: Shady Deals is a crime-power fantasy where building a criminal empire is the central loop and NSFW content is an optional spice layer earned through that empire. The compelling core is the interlocking machine of dirty-vs-clean money, territory control, gang morale management, and faction politics — a miniature Crusader Kings with 1,723 variables. Sex is a reward track for empire-building (arousal-triggered on your turf, job income, combat-loss opt-in) rather than the primary desire-escalation of a predator-climber game; what makes it compelling is the dopamine of watching passive income flows multiply as you control more districts and launder more dirty cash into legitimate empire.
reactive_world_clothing: Partial. $sluttiness (a composite score from clothing's sluttiness rating, not global corruption) gates ambient encounters in districts: sluttiness >= 10 surfaces limo stranger (City Center), downtown duo encounter, suburbs duo encounter, butterfly corner street stroll access (Downtown/Suburbs/Harbor), and streets ass-slap events. $stylishness tracks fashion quality. Clothing is tracked per-slot in $equip object (top/bottom/feet/etc. with sluttiness and style ratings per item). The game does NOT use worn_corruption as a gate on NPC arc spines — consistent with skill doctrine. The reactive world effect is situational ambient triggers, not NPC relationship unlocks. The sluttiness bar is clothing-composite + piercings (pc_nipple_piercing, pc_navel_piercing etc. each contribute). Buttplug equip ($equip.anus) triggers a daily removal/insertion scene at home with video.
time_system: Real-time clock: $gameDate is a JavaScript Date object advancing in UTC minutes/hours. Day-of-week and date displayed in sidebar (Tue Jun 1 08:00 format). Activities consume time (<<addmins 5/15/30>>, <<addhours 1/2>>). Sleep button in Bedroom advances clock to next 08:00 (+adddays 1 if past noon). Day/night gates enforce time windows (car theft 21:00-03:00; racetrack 20:00-03:00). Week cycle implied (weekly bank withdrawal limit, race cooldown $race_cd, bikers heat distraction once/week). NewDay passage runs on each sleep: bank interest, lab production, gang payroll, territory income, heat events, cooldown decrements. No season/calendar beyond day-of-week. Time is a resource that ticks during activities but has no hard end-of-day deadline forcing sleep.
skill_blindspots: A1 VIOLATED — No corruption cascade: There is no single 'player corruption' master meter that gates all lewd content. The game uses p_depravity (controls options WITHIN an already-accessed sex scene), sluttiness (gates public ambient encounters), AND arousal_stage (surfaces opportunity links) as three separate, independent NSFW axes. A2 VIOLATED — No double-lock: Lewd NPC encounters do not require both player-stat tier AND NPC-personal-stat simultaneously. Faction leader sex is gated on faction_met stage (story flag) + situational trigger (arousal_stage==3 OR combat loss). Procgen NPC sex is gated on charm >= NPC.charm (single skill check). There is no 'player depravity floor + NPC depravity lock' double-gate anywhere. Evidence: Foreplay F has no entry gate at all; Slick Trick Quickie entry is charm link post combat loss only.

A3 PARTIAL — The game has the THROTTLE/ODOMETER distinction ($arousal vs $reputation/$volkov_lewd) but adds a third category: OBSTACLE meters ($heat, $gang_morale, $p_hp) that are NOT content gates but ACTIVITY BLOCKERS. The skill has no vocabulary for 'manage-down-to-prevent-setback' meters that are neither content gates nor permanent odometers. Heat and morale are pure risk-management axes that the skill does not model.

A4 NOT APPLICABLE — No four-lane NPC content model: NPCs are not organized by hub-button / ambient / walk-in / capstone. Content delivery is organized by TRIGGER TYPE (arousal-threshold ambient, combat-loss opt-in, job-loop, procgen socialize, faction-story progression, situational caught-events) which is a 6-mode delivery system orthogonal to the skill's 4-lane model. The skill has no concept of 'combat-struggle-sex' as a content delivery mode.

A6 DIRECTLY CONTRADICTED — Two wallets, not one: dirty_money is a separate currency from money, with its own display, balance, and mechanic (laundering). The skill asserts 'ONE wallet (money is money, no dirty/clean split)' as a rule. Shady Deals treats dirty-vs-clean as the central economic tension and design identity. The laundering pipeline (404 Bleach, Mafia auto-center, nightclub, crypto farm, Bikers 3:1) is a core gameplay system the skill has no vocabulary for.

A8 NOT APPLICABLE — Feeder economy inverted: The skill says 'solo/public lewd activities are the SUPPLY that raises corruption.' In Shady Deals, lewd work (brothel, camshow) is one optional income channel among many. The primary income supply chain is crime (heists, drug sales, rackets, car theft, burglary). Sexual activities are a PARALLEL economy track, not a prerequisite feeder. p_depravity rises passively from any sex, not from a designed feeder pipeline.

A9 PARTIALLY CONTRADICTED — The game has structured FAILURE STATES that are real setbacks: territory revolt (morale<20 → district capture reset), combat loss (rep loss + forced recovery), heat events (NPC arrests, asset seizure), heist failures (heat spike + loss). These are not permanent game-overs but they are genuine regression mechanics that the skill explicitly says do not exist. The skill's 'no failure/lose states' claim is false for this game.

A10 PARTIALLY — MC is the escalating agent for empire-building, but LEWD content the MC is frequently the 'acted-upon' party (combat-loss sex, captured-by-captor opt-in, arousal-driven seeking out dominant faction leaders). Volkov, Slick Trick, and Distributor all have dominant/initiating postures in their sex scenes. The MC is a predator in her criminal empire but frequently prey in her NSFW encounters — a split role the skill does not model.

NOVEL CONCEPT NOT IN SKILL — FACTION TERRITORY CAPTURE as progression spine: The game's primary arc is a capture-the-map system (downtown_state/suburbs_state/outskirts_state set by winning faction-leader combat). Territory ownership gates passive income, laundry channels, and content depth. This is closer to a 4X-lite territorial control loop than anything in the skill's lane/corruption/capstone vocabulary.

NOVEL CONCEPT NOT IN SKILL — GANG MANAGEMENT layer: $band_morale (0-100), $band_strength (vs enemy faction str), daily gang payroll, accomplice recruitment, gang revolt at morale<20 — a full management simulation layer that the skill completely lacks vocabulary for. The skill has no NPC-as-managed-resource concept.
